interactions.prompt: Buy arrows and gear from Tor
Read request: The One Who Returned
Read request: The Baker's Last Sack
Read request: A Door Before Winter
Sort the drying stems beside Mira's herb beds
Brace the loose stool at the common table
Hold the hinge against Tor's bench
Set Rook's flour in the common kitchen
Clear the roadside drain with Tor's spade
Leave a share for the western households
Leave a share for the eastern households
Return to the names with Anwen
Help Tor and Rook make tomorrow possible
Meet the road beyond the kitchen
Prepare a meal at the kitchen
Rinse boots and brush the road dust away
Fold Oren's coat out of the weather
Read Before You Take the Road
Set Tor's tools in their rack
Help Rook lift the food cart
Use Tor's tools on the washed-out road
Read the kitchen and relief ledger
